_comment: Sources used under the rights-holder's written permission rather than an open licence. The 'attestation' field records who vouched for the permission and when; attach or cite the underlying email/letter in 'reference' before submission. Do not redistribute source text; derived review CSVs stay inside ml/data (not committed). Sources that could not be opened or ingested (kenyandictionary.ke, Lughayangu, KenyaHub) were removed on 2026-11-20 and can be re-added once data and permission wording are in hand.

permissions.name: Digo-English-Swahili Dictionary (Mwalonya, Nicolle, Nicolle, Zimbu), BTL (East Africa), 2004/2005
permissions.rights_holder: BTL (East Africa) with the Digo Language and Literacy Project
permissions.licence_on_document: Copyright BTL (East Africa). All rights reserved; written permission required beyond short quotations.
permissions.permitted_use: Academic, non-commercial research for the Kenya Watch final-year project: extracting candidate vocabulary into a human-review list. No redistribution of the dictionary text.
permissions.attestation: Project owner (Benvictor Mwangi) stated on 2026-11-20 that this permission was received by email; the email itself has not been seen by the developer tooling.
permissions.reference: Email from George Maina (BTL East Africa), sent 2026-11-19. Keep the original email with the project records.

permissions.name: English-Sheng parallel sentence corpus (provided by the project owner as ml/sheng.md)
permissions.url: local file supplied by the project owner
permissions.rights_holder: Owner of the English and Sheng texts, as identified by the project owner
permissions.licence_on_document: Not stated in the file; the English side matches a copyrighted Bible translation.
permissions.permitted_use: Academic, non-commercial research for the Kenya Watch project: learning a Sheng-to-English word list and word clusters. Only derived word pairs and cluster labels are stored; the text is never committed or redistributed.
permissions.attestation: Project owner (Benvictor Mwangi) stated on 2026-11-21 that they hold the permission and rights from the owner; the permission document has not been seen by the developer tooling.
permissions.reference: Keep the owner's written permission with the project records.

permissions.name: Sheng Dataset (think-ke/sheng-dataset): Sheng dictionary example phrases
permissions.rights_holder: think-ke and the underlying Sheng dictionary's owner
permissions.licence_on_document: No licence file in the repository (all rights reserved by default); data scraped from an online Sheng dictionary.
permissions.permitted_use: Academic, non-commercial research: unlabelled text for word clusters. Not committed or redistributed.
permissions.attestation: Project owner (Benvictor Mwangi) stated on 2026-11-21 that they hold the permission and rights; the permission document has not been seen by the developer tooling.
permissions.reference: Keep the written permission with the project records. ghettoradio.txt named in the README was no longer available (HTTP 404) and was not used.
